summary: Transocean filed an 8-K updating its pending acquisition of Valaris Limited under a February 9, 2026 Business Combination Agreement, exchanging 15.235 Transocean shares per Valaris share. On October 13, 2026, Brazilian competition authority CADE cleared the deal without restrictions; publication in Brazil's Official Journal on October 15-16, 2026 triggers a fifteen-day waiting period before finality, after which all regulatory approval conditions are satisfied. Closing is expected in Q4 2026, subject to remaining conditions. Watch publication timing, finality, any last regulatory conditions and arbitrage spread around the fixed exchange ratio.
